thread:
Maya R.: Heads up — 502 spike on /v1/generate over last 15m, ~3x baseline. Anyone point me to best dash + trace samples? Considering raising debounce on route alert temporarily.
Liam B.: try grafana -> Production > Ingress Errors panel: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/prod-ingress/errors-overview?var-route=/v1/generate :eyes:
Samir K.: use traces service: https://jaeger.redwood.com/search?service=ingress&operation=generate filter by status=502. sample query for logs:
```
service: ingress
route: /v1/generate
status_code: 502
@timestamp: [now-30m TO now]
```
Samir K.: also check prefix-cache timeouts in prefix-cache dashboard (link in sidebar) — sometimes backend cold-starts cause 502s
Ash Patel: which alert are you thinking about? current rule is `ingress.route.error_rate` window=5m threshold=2% firing. we could increase window to 10m and add count-based suppression for short spikes.
Maya R.: yup rule is ingress.route.error_rate. proposing: window=10m, threshold=2.5%, and a 3min mute if rate drops below 1% — want a quick PR + review. @Samir K. can you sanity-check?
Samir K.: sg. quick suggestion: add `for: 3m` and change aggregation to sum over requests, that avoids flapping when traffic low.
Tess: FYI oncall is paged for sustained >1% over 15m. if you change to 10m we should update runbook link in alert text.
Devon: I can take the PR and do review after standup; ping me with link. :thumbsup:
sre-bot: Incident created (auto) — ticket #INC-6421 for 502 surge; assigned to 'ingress-owners'.
Maya R.: thanks all — I'll open a tiny PR with the alert tweak and include dash + trace links. will post PR link here when ready.
Liam B.: if useful, here's a quick dash snapshot of traces + top upstreams: https://grafana.redwood.com/snapshot/xyz123
Maya R.: perfect. closing loop once PR merged. :v:
